current_row.boundary_rationale: אִם שַׂ֣מְתִּי זָהָ֣ב כִּסְלִ֑י ..., “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’” (web:Job.31.24), opens a materialism sequence containing three independently verse-initial protases, not two: trust in gold (Job.31.24), a further wealth-increase clause (Job.31.25, אִם אֶ֭שְׂמַח כִּי רַ֣ב חֵילִ֑י..., “If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great” web:Job.31.25), and astral reverence for sun and moon (Job.31.26, אִם אֶרְאֶ֣ה א֖וֹר כִּ֣י יָהֵ֑ל ...וְ֝יָרֵ֗חַ יָקָ֥ר הֹלֵֽךְ, “if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,” web:Job.31.26). One apodosis follows at Job.31.28 (גַּם ה֭וּא עָוֺ֣ן פְּלִילִ֑י, “this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above” web:Job.31.28), the verdict-formula עון פלילי that elsewhere at Job.31.11 closes one oath immediately preceding it (protasis Job.31.9, apodosis Job.31.10) rather than binding several protases together; the additive גַּם that opens Job.31.28 most directly continues from the astral material immediately before it (Job.31.26-Job.31.27) rather than reaching back to bind the wealth protases of Job.31.24-Job.31.25 into the same apodosis. That reading is disclosed as a live rival, not adopted: the row is chunked as written, with all three protases and the one following apodosis held inside its own span.
current_row.strongest_rejected_alternative: A plausible alternative treats wealth (Job.31.24-Job.31.25) and celestial worship (Job.31.26-Job.31.28) as two separate oaths, each with its own protasis clauses; the verdict-formula parallel with Job.31.11 (skeleton sweep of עון פלילי: 2 book-wide, Job.31.11 and Job.31.28) is disclosed as corroboration for reading Job.31.28's apodosis as answering the immediately preceding astral protasis specifically, rather than as one warrant spanning all three protases of this row, without redrawing the row's own frozen edges.
